session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm trying to stay calm, but my hands are shaking. I keep thinking about what my father might say if I don't include him in everything.
That sounds really heavy. I can see how that would make you feel overwhelmed. Would you like to talk more about what's going on with your father?
I don't know what to say. Every time I try to explain how I feel, he just gets angry. It's like he doesn't understand why I can't just be the way he wants me to be.
That must be so frustrating. I wish there was a way to help you both feel heard. Maybe we could work on some strategies to communicate better?
I wish I could explain without him getting so defensive. I just want him to see that I'm not trying to hurt him, but I can't keep pretending to be someone I'm not.
It's so brave of you to want to be authentic. I think you're doing more than most people ever do. Would you like to try writing down how you feel? It might help you see it more clearly.
I don't know if writing will help. Every time I try to say something, it just makes things worse. I end up apologizing for being myself.
That’s really painful. I can imagine how exhausting it must feel to always apologize for who you are. Maybe we could explore some ways to set boundaries that feel safer for you?
I don’t know how to set boundaries without feeling like I’m pushing him away. I keep thinking he’ll leave if I say no, and I can’t bear the thought of losing him.
You’re not alone in feeling that way. It’s natural to fear losing the people we care about. But what if we tried something different—like finding a way to say no without it feeling like a rejection?
I don’t know how to say no without making him feel like I don’t care. I just want him to understand that I’m not trying to hurt him, but I can’t keep doing this.
You’re trying so hard to make things work, and that’s admirable. I think you deserve to be seen for who you are, not just what you think others want you to be.
I know, but it feels like every time I try, I just end up hurting someone. I don’t know how to stop hurting people without hurting myself.
It’s so brave of you to keep trying, even when it feels like you’re hurting. You’re not alone in this, and you don’t have to do it all by yourself.
I just want to feel like I’m not alone, but every time I try to reach out, it feels like I’m just making things worse. I don’t know how to stop feeling this way.
You’re not alone in feeling this way, and it’s okay to feel stuck. I’m here to help you find a way forward, even if it feels impossible right now.
I don’t know if there’s a way forward. I just feel like I’m trapped, and no matter what I do, I can’t escape the pain.
You’re not trapped, and you don’t have to face this alone. I’m here to walk with you, even if it feels like we’re both still learning how to move forward together.
I don’t know how to believe that. Every time I try to hope, something happens to remind me that I’m not safe. I just want to stop hurting.
